records.dataset_name: Evaluating the Use and Feasibility of Indocyanine Green (ICG) in Sentinel Node Biopsy for Breast Cancer: A Beacon of Precision from an Oncoplastic Practice in India - Supplementary Information
records.anatomy_scope: breast_and_axillary_sentinel_lymph_node; no jaw or bone target
records.modality: human intraoperative ICG fluorescence supplementary videos
records.channel_availability: requires per-video visual review; source metadata does not define channel layout
records.labels: Supplementary video identities S1-S3 only; no pixel segmentation masks, bone labels, necrotic-transition-viable labels, or frame-level quality labels
records.patient_count_unavailable_reason: The Zenodo record does not publish a patient-to-video mapping or an independent patient count.
records.clinical_variables_unavailable_reason: No patient-level age, sex, comorbidity, medication, laboratory, or blood-index table is published.
records.recommended_use: MP4/video decoding, ICG temporal signal quality anomalies, playback, ignore/abstention, and non-target-domain robustness engineering validation after manual content review.
records.prohibited_use: No jaw-osteomyelitis, bone-viability, patient-conditioned segmentation, diagnostic, resection-boundary, navigation, or clinical-performance claim.

records.data_boundary: Public CC BY 4.0 human breast-cancer sentinel-lymph-node ICG supplementary videos. They are non-jaw, non-bone, and non-target-domain proxy data. They provide no jaw-osteomyelitis ground truth, bone-surface mask, bone-activity class, patient clinical variables, or physician segmentation. Training admission remains false.

medical_boundary: D090 is restricted to public non-target-domain ICG video engineering validation. It remains excluded from target-domain training and all clinical performance claims.
